business_capabilities.name: Conversational Driver Rescheduling
business_capabilities.description: Receive driver delay, breakdown, or early-arrival messages in English, Hindi, or Hinglish via Telegram or signed HTTP channel; derive ETA; auto-hold first feasible slot; confirm or decline; cancel appointments.

business_capabilities.name: Deterministic ETA & Feasibility Evaluation
business_capabilities.description: Derive arrival times from explicit ETA, repair+travel, late-by offset, gate-in, and GPS arrival floor; evaluate slots across 5 gates (snapshot freshness, hard dock/weight/temp/hour rules, labour/consignee completeness, crew/equipment coverage, consignee commitment).

business_capabilities.name: Concurrency-Safe Capacity & Hold Management
business_capabilities.description: FCFS temporary slot holds sharing database unique constraints with confirmed appointments; atomic confirmation swapping original and replacement; lazy and periodic hold expiry.

business_capabilities.name: Warehouse Dock & Exception Operations
business_capabilities.description: 24/7 rolling 14-day slot generation from staff-entered crew counts; dock board view; dock blocking with displacement preview/auto-move; freeing slots; direct driver messaging; escalation case resolution with optional slot booking.

business_capabilities.name: Facility Change & Partner Warehouse Coordination
business_capabilities.description: Driver-initiated destination facility change requests approved by destination warehouse; asynchronous SMTP/IMAP email approval workflow for partner warehouses with strict reply parsing and SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification.

business_capabilities.name: Shipment Assignment, Dock Access Pass & Gate Control
business_capabilities.description: Warehouse shipment creation with 128-bit hashed Dock Access Pass delivered over Telegram; one-time driver chat confirmation (5-attempt lockout); security guard pass/vehicle/licence validation, check-in, unloading completion, check-out, and overstay sweeps.

business_capabilities.name: Escalation Handoff & Coordinator Workflow
business_capabilities.description: Safe human handoff with deduplicated cases, 18 reason codes, lifecycle (OPEN/CLAIMED/RESOLVED/CANCELLED + 24h reopen), web & CLI coordinator interfaces, and fsync JSONL fallback on DB outage.

business_capabilities.name: Identity, RBAC, Driver Onboarding & Platform Administration
business_capabilities.description: Invite-only Google OIDC, optional email/password login, break-glass local admin, Telegram phone binding, facility-scoped RBAC, driver onboarding/approval/soft-delete, project allocations, encrypted runtime configuration, model usage reporting, and immutable audit logging.

business_rules.name: Operational Timezone IST
business_rules.rule: All operational timestamps must carry an explicit offset and are normalized to Asia/Kolkata (IST).

business_rules.name: ETA Late-By Baseline (D6)
business_rules.rule: 'N minutes late' defaults to shipments.original_eta_ts unless explicitly referencing current ETA; gate-in + delay report yields CONTRADICTORY_ARRIVAL_STATE.

business_rules.name: GPS Arrival Floor & Freshness
business_rules.rule: GPS pings expire after 15 min; road travel = ceil(haversine * 1.3 / 40 km/h * 60); GPS acts strictly as a lower bound on arrival (never makes ETA earlier) and lowers confidence if gap > 30 min.

business_rules.name: Fail-Closed Feasibility Completeness (D10/D18)
business_rules.rule: Missing labour_windows, missing consignee_commitments, or facility snapshot age > 5 min returns INCOMPLETE_FEASIBILITY_DATA; availability is never assumed.

business_rules.name: Hard Slot Compatibility Rules
business_rules.rule: Slots must be OPEN, in future, on ACTIVE dock without blocking dock events, unoccupied/unheld, within facility hours and LAST_NEW_START_TIME, matching dock type/reefer/heavy/weight limits, fitting expected_unload_min (+0.5m), and after release_time + eta_buffer_minutes.

business_rules.name: FCFS Hold Allocation & Contention (D5/D24)
business_rules.rule: Priority never pre-empts an existing hold. Holds live in appointments(status='HELD', is_current=0) sharing ux_active_appointment_per_slot; max 1 live hold per shipment; standard TTL 180s (900s for proactive GPS/facility-change holds).

business_rules.name: Atomic Confirmation Swap (D28)
business_rules.rule: Confirmation runs inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE, re-validating feasibility and on-site status, ending the original appointment (CANCELLED, is_current=0) and promoting the hold (CONFIRMED, is_current=1) atomically.

business_rules.name: Auto-Hold One-Slot Flow (D93)
business_rules.rule: System auto-holds the rank-1 feasible slot; driver replies Yes to confirm or No to release and auto-hold the next unoffered slot.

business_rules.name: Two-Turn Cancellation & 120-Min Cutoff
business_rules.rule: Confirmed cancellation requires a preview turn + explicit Yes within 10 min; refused if truck on site or IN_PROGRESS; escalated if < 120 min before slot start or consignee commitment is unknown/penalty-bearing/exceptional.

business_rules.name: LLM Write Checkpoints & System-Worded State
business_rules.rule: Write tools require verbatim driver_quote in current message, max 1 write/message, and cannot confirm a hold created in the same message. Committed state replies are rendered deterministically from DB rows, never by the LLM.

business_rules.name: 24/7 Rolling 14-Day Horizon (D105)
business_rules.rule: Facilities operate 00:00-00:00; 1-hour slots and AUTO labour windows are generated 14 days ahead ONLY for active non-partner facilities where staff entered facility_crews.crews >= 1.

business_rules.name: Facility Change Approval & Revert
business_rules.rule: Only destination warehouse authority (or Admin) approves facility changes (120m TTL). Approval moves destination_facility_id and auto-holds (15m) or requests partner slot; if unconfirmed/no slot, reverts to original facility.

business_rules.name: Partner Warehouse Strict Email Approval (D69)
business_rules.rule: Partner booking requires active facility contact, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication in live mode, and bare APPROVE/DECLINE on line 1; anything ambiguous escalates and never books.

business_rules.name: Dock Access Pass Issuance, Confirmation & Gate Order
business_rules.rule: 128-bit random pass (DAP-...) stored only as SHA-256; valid [slot_start - early_limit(60m), slot_end + 4h]. Driver confirms once in chat (5 failed guesses lock shipment). Gate checks in fixed order: PASS_NOT_VALID -> WRONG_WAREHOUSE -> ALREADY_CHECKED_IN -> TOO_EARLY -> TOO_LATE -> NO_APPOINTMENT -> DRIVER_NOT_ELIGIBLE -> DETAILS_DO_NOT_MATCH.

business_rules.name: Driver Eligibility & Invite-Only Web Access
business_rules.rule: Drivers must be ACTIVE/OFF_DUTY, APPROVED (if app-onboarded), with non-expired licence. Web users are invite-only and facility-scoped (except ADMIN); out-of-scope probes return 404.

business_rules.name: Seed Database Immutability (D3/D97)
business_rules.rule: data/setuhaul.sqlite3 is SHA-256 pinned; live service and set_admin_password.py refuse to run on it.

non_functional_requirements.specification: Zero double-booked slots and zero invariant violations under concurrent thread/process contention; SQLite WAL + BEGIN IMMEDIATE + 5000ms busy timeout.
Capacity search p99 < 500ms (measured 13.4ms on 826 slots); single-writer SQLite saturates at ~244 holds/s (p99 4.2s at 16 writers). Real-LLM latency unmeasured at scale.
Max 6 model rounds, 4 executed tool calls, 8s per-call timeout, 1 retry, 30s request deadline, 800 output tokens, $0.05 cost cap; prompt leak and unverified-claim output guards.
Server-side RBAC + facility scoping, HMAC-SHA256 webhooks, scrypt password hashing, Fernet secret encryption at rest, SameSite=Lax + same-origin CSRF check, strict CSP on HTML, append-only audit log.
Single-process container deployment; Redis outage degrades cache/rate-limit (fail-open for driver msgs, fail-closed for OAuth/gate); DB outage falls back to fsync JSONL escalation file.
non_functional_requirements.status: Verified in tests; Unverified in production

non_functional_requirements.specification: Structured redacted JSON logs, in-memory spans, immutable appointment_events/escalation_events/audit_log, optional scrubbed LangSmith tracing, model_turns/model_calls telemetry. No OTel export or metrics scraping.
DPDP/GDPR compliance unassessed; opt-in retention disabled by default; no DB encryption at rest; no bot privacy notice/consent flow.
